summary: Removed three fixed feature groups separately and refitted ridge on 20 independent synthetic stable/stress pairs. Training alone fits preprocessing and coefficients; validation selects penalties and a feature variant; calibration sets residual bands and test only evaluates frozen choices. Two studio cases preserve all removals, baselines, paired uncertainty summaries and negative findings. Exact target ranges, input validation and a measured row-perturbation audit expose selection isolation. All 32 unit tests, the trusted independent contract and six-case studio reproduction pass.
